第5章 黑子的篮球五
自从那天自己发现不知道什么时候有了一条门缝过后，原田就充分的理解到了什么叫做谣言，什么叫做跟风。
“大哥好！”原田头上的青筋一跳一跳，看吧，刚说了就来了几个不长眼的…
原田一脸乌云密布，对于几人“颇有礼貌”的问好置若罔闻。
不要问他问什么不解释，你以为他没有尝试过吗…
但是大家一致认为，这是一种对赤司绝对的挑衅，不管从哪方面来说，都不像是真的要对戏。虽然说实际上也的确不是，但是并不是为了要挑衅啊。
在经历过无数次苦口婆心的解释却赢来无数闪烁着“解释就是掩饰，掩饰就是事实”的眼神过后，某只彻底放弃了解释，转而进行无视之这种消极抵抗。
不过…作为谣言的另一男主角，赤司倒很是气定神闲，好整以暇。
不仅没有对这种流言采取任何手段，而且没有说出任何关于这个谣言的任何否决性的言论，于是在众人的眼中，这就是赤司保持认同众人观点的态度了。
因为赤司的手段众人早就领教过了，一出手就是一阵血雨腥风的雷霆手段怕是没有人想要尝试。
如果赤司真的有意反对的话，你以为他们的皮都很痒吗噬天。
所以说，无论我们的原田同学说些什么，大家都采取无视之的态度。
原田第一天训练的工作倒是和其他部员也没有什么太大的区别，新部员都是需要先捡球或者打扫场地的，这是传统很正常。
原田完全懒得去想这些事，颇为自得的看着窗外看个风景自娱自乐。
闭上眼睛趴在桌上，原田索性开始睡觉。
对于原田上课公然睡觉的行为，各科老师倒是想管，但是同样热爱八卦的老师们也听说了原田貌似连赤司都敢挑衅，自己让原田罚站什么的，谁知道会怎么样。所以，老师们倒是像说好了似得对于原田上课公然睡觉的行为视而不见。
不过…腹黑的老师们在心里偷笑，明天就是期中考了，家长会也会在之后召开，原田总是不听课是不可能考好的，到时候自己向他的父母参上一本，可就不用担心了。
于是当天晚上，正无聊的原田很诧异地听黑子说当天的训练取消了，因为第二天要进行期中考试。原田无所谓的点点头，“哦。”
见黑子一脸淡定的样子原田感觉大概黑子成绩也不错。他忘记了黑子的成绩怎么样了。
于是，就在黑子平静的表象下，其实是一颗不为人知的忐忑的心？

和黑子一起回家之后，心情不错的原田睡了很长一觉，然后第二天神清气爽的上学去了。
而原田休息好了，心情也好了的前提下，让考生们哀鸿遍野的期中考也就做的更加顺手了起来。
等到考试结束后，大家一起出去庆祝考试结束，原田也就显得特别淡定，随口找了个要回家睡觉的理由就放了大家的鸽子。
然后，堪称灾难日的成绩发放日到来了。老师们热泪盈眶的拿着成绩单，吐沫横飞的演说着，“我们学校一直以来以篮球文明，但是如今，我们继赤司之后又出了一个拿得出手的同学。哦不，又是一个天才。”
“这个学生的成绩和本校的赤司同学分数一样。”
“原田律同学。”
老师们一个个激动的让原田怀疑他们是不是下一秒就要晕过去了，然后在听完了老师们对他的赞美之后便是对其他人恨铁不成钢的狂轰滥炸。
“要知道，原田同学上课天天睡觉，隔三差五走神，从来不听课；而你们，上课一丝不苟，认认真真，笔记记满好几本。”
原田嘴角抽搐，老师你这是损我呢吧损我呢吧。
“可是————你们竟然都没他考得好，让老师们…情何以堪啊。”
说实话吧，这才是重点是吧。
总之，一堂班会课就在老师们无比悲愤的陈述中落下了帷幕。
而同学们显然丝毫没有感受到老师们的良苦用心，他们从口水中侥幸生存下来得到的结论就是————这丫的扮猪吃老虎，原田是天才。
于是，无意中躺枪的某原田在众人的集体吐槽中举手投降，乖乖的掏了腰包请同学们吃饭，在众人的风卷残云中风中凌乱，悲愤的比了比中指————
小爷我整整三个月的私房钱啊。

Chapter 5 Kuroko’s Basketball Five
Ever since that day when he discovered that there was a crack in the door, Harada fully understood what rumors were and what following the trend meant.
"Hello, brother!" The veins on Harada's head were twitching. Look, as soon as he said it, a few blind people came...
Harada had a dark look on his face and turned a deaf ear to the "very polite" greetings from several people.
Don't ask him why he doesn't explain. Do you think he hasn't tried...
But everyone agreed that this was an absolute provocation to Akaashi. No matter from which aspect, it didn't seem like a real confrontation. Although it is actually not the case, it is not for the purpose of provocation.
After experiencing countless painstaking explanations but winning countless looks that said "explanation is cover-up, cover-up is fact", a certain bird completely gave up on explanation and turned to passive resistance of ignoring it.
But... as the other male protagonist of the rumor, Akashi is very calm and relaxed, taking a lot of time.
Not only did he not take any measures against this rumor, but he also did not say any negative words about this rumor. Therefore, in the eyes of everyone, this was Akashi's attitude of agreeing with everyone's opinions.
Because everyone has already experienced Akashi's methods, and no one would want to try the thunderous method that causes a bloody storm as soon as he strikes.
If Akashi really intends to object, do you think their skin will be itchy?
Therefore, no matter what our Harada-san says, everyone ignores it.
Harada's work on the first day of training was not much different from that of other members. New members were required to pick up balls or clean the court first. This is tradition and normal.
Harada was completely too lazy to think about these things, and looked out the window to amuse himself with the scenery.
Closing his eyes and lying on the table, Harada simply started to sleep.
Regarding Harada's behavior of openly sleeping in class, the teachers in various subjects wanted to take care of it, but the teachers who also loved gossip also heard that Harada seemed to dare to provoke even Akaashi. Who knew what would happen if he made Harada stand for a long time or something. Therefore, the teachers seemed to have agreed to turn a blind eye to Harada sleeping openly in class.
But... the scheming teachers snickered in their hearts. Tomorrow is the mid-term exam, and the parent-teacher meeting will be held after that. Harada always refuses to listen to the class and it is impossible to pass the exam. When the time comes, he will take a copy from his parents, so there is no need to worry.
So that night, Harada, who was bored, was surprised to hear Kuroko say that the training for that day was canceled because there was a midterm exam the next day. Harada nodded indifferently, "Oh."
Seeing Kuroko's calm expression, Harada felt that Kuroko's grades were probably good. He had forgotten what Kuroko's grades were.
So, beneath Heizi's calm appearance, is there actually an unknown and anxious heart?
After returning home with Kuroko, Harada was in a good mood and took a long nap, then went to school refreshed the next day.
Now that Harada had rested and was in a better mood, the midterm exam, which was so frustrating for the candidates, became easier to do.
After the exam was over, everyone went out to celebrate the end of the exam. Harada seemed particularly calm. He casually found an excuse to go home and sleep and let everyone go.
Then, the day of disastrous results came. The teachers held the report cards with tears in their eyes and spoke in a vomiting manner, "Our school has always been a basketball culture, but now, after Akaashi, we have another classmate who is very good. Oh no, another genius."
"This student's grades are the same as Akaashi's from our school."
"Harada Ritsu-san."
The teachers were so excited that Harada wondered if they would faint in the next second, and then after listening to the teachers' praise for him, he said:Others hate the indiscriminate bombardment.
"You know, Harada-san sleeps every day in class, gets distracted every now and then, and never pays attention to the lectures; but you, on the other hand, are meticulous and conscientious in class, and have several books full of notes."
The corners of Harada's mouth twitched, "Teacher, are you hurting me? Are you hurting me?"
"But--you didn't do as well in the exam as he did. How can the teachers... be embarrassed?"
Let's be honest, that's the point, right?
In short, the class meeting ended with extremely sad and angry statements from the teachers.
The students obviously didn't feel the teachers' good intentions at all. The conclusion they came to from the lucky survival was that this girl was pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger. Harada was a genius.
So, a certain Harada who accidentally laid a gun on his hands raised his hands in surrender amidst the collective complaints from everyone, and obediently dug into his pockets to treat his classmates to dinner. Amidst the chaos of the crowd, Harada raised his middle finger in grief and indignation————
Young master, I have three full months of private money.
